children: Mentari Therapeutics completed a 1-for-10 consolidation, reducing shares outstanding from 5,493,735 to approximately 549,374. Shareholders approved the merger share issuance and related change of control; merger closing remains subject to conditions.
Reduces the share count and adjusts per-share option and warrant terms proportionately; it does not itself change holders’ proportional ownership.
The stated post-consolidation count is approximately one-tenth of the prior count; no cash was paid for fractional-share rounding.
Merger issuance and change of control approved
Shareholders approved issuance representing more than 20% of pre-merger shares and the resulting change of control, but closing is not yet assured.
Company name changed to Mentari Therapeutics, Inc.
The legal name change is effective today; the release says the Nasdaq symbol remains INM.

This is a late-stage transaction step, with the consolidation completed and merger-related proposals approved. The larger catalyst is completion of the merger after its remaining closing conditions are satisfied or waived.
